name: Purple Lingzhi Gourd (Tử Chi Hồ Lô)
lore: A gourd grown on the founder's own vine in 482 and cured with the spores of a purple lingzhi, so that what is put in it goes on living. Valley-mistresses have carried their herbs in it for seven hundred years. Nghiêm Linh Chi keeps a sprig of every herb a child of the valley has ever planted in it, and none of them has wilted.
build_use: The mistress's alchemy and sustain: stronger pills, longer Wood buffs and poison resistance.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Cinder Censer of Lăng Tiêu (Lăng Tiêu Tẫn Lô)
lore: A small bronze censer the alchemist Diêu Tẫn Đan carried out of the burning pill hall of Lăng Tiêu Các in 1066 (V050), with a coal of the fire still in it. The coal has not gone out in a hundred and thirty years. The valley will not let it into the herb terraces.
build_use: The guest elder's furnace in a fight: Fire damage and burns, at a cost.
made_by: the alchemists of Lăng Tiêu Các

name: Grain Rain Fan (Cốc Vũ Phiến)
lore: A fan of lotus leaf on bamboo ribs that sprinkles water when it is opened. Cố Hoài Sơn watered the high terraces with it and gave it to the girl he found on the roof.
build_use: The rain: heals and Water buffs over the field she stands on.

name: Bell of the Herb Terraces (Chi Điền Chung)
lore: The wooden bell that calls the valley's children to weed at dawn. Every valley-mistress has rung it herself for her first ten years in the post.
build_use: Spores that stay on a foe, and a body that does not wilt.
